import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { badgeColorClass, badgeVariants, type BadgeColor, type BadgeVariantProps } from "."

interface Props extends PrimitiveProps {
  variant?: BadgeVariantProps["variant"]
  color?: BadgeColor
  highContrast?: boolean
  class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
}

  as: "span",
  variant: "default",
  highContrast: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="badge"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :data-variant="variant"
    :data-color="color"
    :class="
      cn(
        badgeVariants({ variant: color ? 'ghost' : variant }),
        color ? badgeColorClass[color][highContrast ? 'contrast' : 'soft'] : null,
        props.class,
      )
    "
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner"
import { buttonVariants, type ButtonVariantProps } from "."

interface Props extends PrimitiveProps {
  variant?: ButtonVariantProps["variant"]
  size?: ButtonVariantProps["size"]
  class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  disabled?: boolean
  /** Shows a Spinner, sets aria-busy, and blocks clicks while keeping focus. */
  loading?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  as: "button",
  variant: "default",
  size: "default",
})

const iconOnly = computed(() => typeof props.size === "string" && props.size.startsWith("icon"))

// A loading button stays focusable (no disabled attribute) but swallows clicks.
function blockWhileLoading(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (props.loading) {
    event.preventDefault()
    event.stopImmediatePropagation()
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="button"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :disabled="disabled || undefined"
    :data-loading="loading ? '' : undefined"
    :aria-busy="loading || undefined"
    :aria-disabled="loading || undefined"
    :class="
      cn(
        buttonVariants({ variant, size }),
        // The Spinner takes the place of a leading icon instead of sitting beside it.
        'data-loading:cursor-progress data-loading:[&>[data-icon=inline-start]:not([data-slot=spinner])]:hidden',
        props.class,
      )
    "
    @click="blockWhileLoading"
  >
    <!-- The Spinner is decoration here: aria-busy on the button carries the state. -->
    <Spinner v-if="loading && iconOnly" :role="undefined" :aria-label="undefined" aria-hidden="true" />
    <template v-else>
      <Spinner
        v-if="loading"
        :role="undefined"
        :aria-label="undefined"
        aria-hidden="true"
        data-icon="inline-start"
      />
      <slot />
    </template>
  </Primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import {
  SelectContent,
  SelectPortal,
  SelectViewport,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
  type SelectContentEmits,
  type SelectContentProps,
} from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

// "item-aligned" lines the selected item up with the trigger, like the React
// alignItemWithTrigger default. Pass position="popper" for a dropdown under it.
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SelectContentProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), {
  position: "item-aligned",
  side: "bottom",
  sideOffset: 4,
  align: "center",
})
const emits = defineEmits<SelectContentEmits>()

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegated, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <SelectPortal>
    <SelectContent
      data-slot="select-content"
      v-bind="{ ...$attrs, ...forwarded }"
      :class="
        cn(
          'relative isolate z-50 flex min-w-36 flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-lg ring-1 ring-foreground/5 duration-100 dark:ring-foreground/10 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95',
          position === 'popper' &&
            'max-h-(--reka-select-content-available-height) w-(--reka-select-trigger-width) origin-(--reka-select-content-transform-origin)',
          props.class,
        )
      "
    >
      <!-- The viewport scrolls, not the popup, so the fade masks the items and not the popup's surface. -->
      <SelectViewport class="min-h-0 flex-1 scroll-fade">
        <slot />
      </SelectViewport>
    </SelectContent>
  </SelectPortal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipRoot,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
  type TooltipRootEmits,
  type TooltipRootProps,
} from "reka-ui"

const props = defineProps<TooltipRootProps>()
const emits = defineEmits<TooltipRootEmits>()
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Reka needs a provider above every tooltip. This one makes a lone Tooltip work;
       wrap a group in TooltipProvider to share its delay. -->
  <TooltipProvider>
    <TooltipRoot v-slot="slotProps" v-bind="forwarded">
      <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
    </TooltipRoot>
  </TooltipProvider>
</template>

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import {
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipPortal,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
  type TooltipContentEmits,
  type TooltipContentProps,
} from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { popupClassName } from "@/components/ui/styles"

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<TooltipContentProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), {
  sideOffset: 6,
})
const emits = defineEmits<TooltipContentEmits>()

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegated, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <TooltipPortal>
    <TooltipContent
      data-slot="tooltip-content"
      v-bind="{ ...$attrs, ...forwarded }"
      :class="cn(popupClassName, 'z-50 max-w-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs', props.class)"
    >
      <slot />
    </TooltipContent>
  </TooltipPortal>
</template>
